messages:
Nora Vega: quick thread on compact usage canvas: kebab menu per row vs top-level bulk download for invoices + where token breakdown lives. mock: https://redwood.app/u/1855555555/mock.png
Chris Huang: kebab keeps rows tidy, exposes actions on demand. less visual noise. accountants might miss it though. :eyes:
Jules Martin: toolbar bulk CTA scales well for power users doing exports. but ambiguous if scope = selected / filtered / org. need clear label.
AccessibilityBot: accessibility note: any action must have an accessible name with scope and date range, e.g., "Download invoice for Acme — Mar 2025 (PDF)". kebab menus need proper aria-expanded state and keyboard support.
Nora Vega: what about hybrid: kebab with a primary inline "Download (PDF)" affordance for the most common rows, falling back to toolbar when multiple selected. keeps discoverability and reduces clicks.
Chris Huang: hybrid seems fine. Implementation concern: per-row visible CTA might reintroduce many nodes in the virtualized list. we should prefer a single delegated handler and render visible button only for focused/hovered rows.
Jules Martin: token breakdown options: inline collapsible row vs right-side flyout. Flyout keeps list compact but breaks reading flow. inline is simpler UX-wise for keyboard users.
AccessibilityBot: inline collapsible works better for screen readers if you announce collapse open/close via aria-live and manage focus to the expanded region. ensure the expand control is reachable via keyboard without extra tab stops.
DesignOps: microcopy suggestions: kebab action -> "Download invoice (PDF)"; toolbar -> "Download invoices (selected)"; flyout -> "Token breakdown". include visually-hidden text with project/org info.
Nora Vega: acceptance checklist for prototype: 1) keyboard operable without extra tabs, 2) SR announces scope when downloading, 3) virtualization perf baseline maintained, 4) discoverability test with 5 users.
Chris Huang: I'll do a quick perf spike with delegated click + intersection observer to only hydrate visible rows.
Jules Martin: I'll update Figma frames with 3 variants: A) kebab-only, B) toolbar-primary, C) hybrid (kebab+inline primary). will add microcopy per variant.
Nora Vega: sweet. post frames here when ready and we'll pick the AB test metric set (downloads, keyboard pct, support tickets).
DesignOps: tagging @AccessibilityBot for final aria copy before dev handoff. :sparkles:
